clips.title: The story
paras: Camping 101: First Aid introduces adventurers to wilderness survival by teaching them how to craft a field medical kit for their campsite. Instructed by Byancie in Dolanaar, it emphasizes self-reliance and practical triage far away from town clinics.

Venturing deep into the wilds carries constant hazard, from beast bites to jagged terrain. For rangers and field travelers, medical supplies cannot always wait for a return to town. Learning to assemble a dedicated First Aid Kit turns a simple roadside rest into a functional field station, ensuring that minor scrapes do not turn fatal under the open sky.

Byancie, found among the shaded bowers of Dolanaar, instructs travelers skilled in triage on how to package medical supplies suitable for rough trail life. Setting up such gear requires respect for local settlements; townsfolk do not tolerate pitched tents and messy supplies in town centers, requiring campers to strike out into the forest before establishing their camp.

Every functional encampment begins with an open flame. Before setting down medical kits or bedding, adventurers must lay down a campfire for warmth and protection. Because building and tending a fire is foundational to field survival, trainers recommend consulting a cook to master the art of kindling before attempting to maintain a wilderness camp.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... And pragmatic pursuit as a hunter.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
